title: Why Choose Ujtö̀?

fast.title: Lightning Fast
fast.desc: Get your video transcriptions in seconds, not minutes. Our optimized AI processes videos up to 10x faster than competitors with instant access to your complete transcription history.

accurate.title: Accurate transcripts
accurate.desc: Powered by the open-source Whisper speech-recognition model, with punctuation and support for many languages and accents. Every transcript is saved to your personal history.

secure.title: Complete History
secure.desc: Access all your transcriptions anytime with our comprehensive history tracking. Search, organize, and manage your video transcripts with intelligent video title extraction.
